text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho. Every Umamusume who has a good showing in this race is remembered by history as an exemplary racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, Kitasan Black strides boldly forward to claim the prestigious plaque that serves as its reward.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Here we are at the second hurdle! This might be the highest mountain I've got to conquer this spring.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If I run well here, everybody will know for sure how strong I am, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to run in the Takarazuka Kinen if I do well today too, right?
choice_data_list: Yep! You'll be a household name!
Yep! You'll be a household name!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to be an Umamusume with a name for herself and the skills to back it up. If she can prove herself here, she's sure to earn that title.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aaall right! Here I go! Time to face this mountain head-on and crush it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll kick it to the curb with these legs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black stands tall and proud at the paddock. Meanwhile, two figures watch her closely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black… She has always been stubbornly driven, but she never felt like a threat.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Brusquement, keep a sharp eye on her. You must judge for yourself how much of a danger she is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This 3,200-meter race in Kyoto will provide an apt litmus test. Let's see what that Umamusume has made of herself.
